content.title: Route to Homes results with destination, valid dates, and guests preserved
content.intent: Prove the complete-input flow routes from the homepage to Homes results and preserves destination, dates, and guests in the results header.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: state_flow for homepage-to-results navigation; eqp for typed destination classes. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No covering-array reduction was needed because the outcome stays the same and only destination type varies materially in-source; this scenario sweeps city and region as equivalent destination representatives.
